Basic ATC

Funkkontakt mit Tower aufnehmen

Instruction from ATC to switch radio communication from the current frequency to the aerodrome control tower frequency for landing or taxi clearance.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Funkkontakt mit Tower aufnehmen?

In this glossary, Funkkontakt mit Tower aufnehmen refers to: Instruction from ATC to switch radio communication from the current frequency to the aerodrome control tower frequency for landing or taxi clearance.

How is Funkkontakt mit Tower aufnehmen used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "ATC: American 782, kontaktieren Sie den Tower auf 118.7 zur Landeerlaubnis."

Why does Funkkontakt mit Tower aufnehmen matter in aviation?

Funkkontakt mit Tower aufnehmen matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Definition

Instruction from ATC to switch radio communication from the current frequency to the aerodrome control tower frequency for landing or taxi clearance.

Operational example

ATC: American 782, contact tower on 118.7 for landing clearance.
